The deal

GTA 6, explored slowly. Nothing spoiled. Nothing else like it.

This is where GTA fans live — the ones who want Vice City on in the background, on the big screen, on loop. Free roam only — I set up a spot, talk a little, then go quiet and let Leonida sound like Leonida. That's the whole empire, and nobody does it bigger.

01

Spoiler-free, always

No story missions. No cutscenes, no plot, no endings. If it's story, it's not on this channel — free roam in Vice City and Leonida only.

02

Voice on, no facecam

You hear me, you don't watch me. The game fills the screen — GTA 6 gameplay the way it actually looks and sounds, start to finish.

03

Radio off

Licensed music stays off, so what you hear is the world itself: rain, waves, traffic, NPC chatter, engines, footsteps. Clean audio, no copyright noise.

The flagship series

Sounds of Leonida

The series that built the channel. One spot at a time, held long enough to actually hear it — beach at dawn, downtown in the rain, the wetlands at dusk — and chat picks where we go next.

The beach at dawn

First light over the water, empty boulevard, city barely awake. The quietest Vice City gets.

Waves · gulls · distant traffic · footsteps on wet pavement

Downtown in the rain

Neon on wet streets, rain on rooftops, traffic rolling past. Park up, engine off, just listen.

Rain · tires on wet roads · neon hum · NPC chatter

The wetlands at dusk

Out past the city — still water, cypress trees, and Leonida going dark. No neon out here.

Frogs · insects · water · wind through the grass

Spot artwork is original illustration in the spirit of Leonida — not game screenshots. Real gameplay is on the streams.
